description.text:
Banish (逐) is one of the two booster packs of Shadow of the Blue Sea (碧海暗影), alongside Roar (啸). Shadow of the Blue Sea was the sixth Sword & Shield booster release in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 20 September 2024 in 5-card packs with one holo and 25-card packs with five. The Legendary Pokémon Lugia and Giratina lead it, each with a VSTAR Power.

Banish brings back the Lost Zone, last seen in the Sun & Moon series: a zone apart from the discard pile, where cards stay for the rest of the game. Its cover Pokémon, Giratina, comes as Giratina V and Giratina VSTAR, whose VSTAR Power attack, Star Requiem, Knocks Out the opponent's Active Pokémon once its player has ten or more cards in the Lost Zone. Many of its cards help fill the Lost Zone: Comfey, whose Ability, Flower Selecting, looks at the top two cards of the deck, keeps one and sends the other there; Cramorant, which attacks for no Energy once four cards are there; Banette; the Supporter Colress's Experiment; the Item Lost Vacuum; and the Stadium Lost City, which sends Knocked Out Pokémon to the Lost Zone.

Banish also has Keldeo, whose attack hits much harder with Cobalion, Terrakion and Virizion on the Bench (Cobalion and Virizion are in Roar); Claydol and Stonjourner, which are stronger while their player's discard pile holds no Supporter; Froslass and Glalie, whose attacks are stronger in a turn their player used the Supporter Melony; and the Radiant Pokémon Alakazam and Eternatus. Its main cards are numbered out of 131; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare, rainbow and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 172.
